question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever changed your life because of a dream?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: As a highly experienced love-advice specialist, I think I can see what's going on here.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're not over Sam.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You don't exactly have to be an expert to see that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There `might` be something to that... I've been a little on edge since I ran into her at the skate park.
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#e23b3b][i]might[/i][/color] be something to that... I've been a little on edge since I ran into her at the skate park.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys... It's becoming clear to me what we need to do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The love bug is biting you in all of the wrong places, and I've got the only cure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A guys-only camping trip.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We can head up to my uncle's property in the mountains.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We can get up in the cool mountain air, away from all this heat, and really clear our heads.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax, leave our troubles behind, and forget about our girl problems!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... I guess it couldn't be any worse than it is here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I did promise my parents to spend at least one day away from my computer this summer.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I wouldn't mind blowing town for a day or two. Our house doesn't even have AC.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sounds like it's settled! You guys get packed, and I'll gas up the Party Van. It's time to do some camping!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Colt! Bro! She `was` crying over you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! Bro! She [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] crying over you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She... She was?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, not `directly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, not [color=#e23b3b][i]directly.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But it's clear that your breakup has left her in a fragile emotional state!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You... You think so?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Losing a stud like you? Any girl would be devastated.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Face or stomach?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe... Neither?
Colt punches Howard in the stomach!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oof!
Brendan steps between Howard and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Back off, Colt. He wasn't trying to hurt Sam's feelings. She was upset because of $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now drop your fists. I'd hate to have to hit you with some of my signature fighting moves.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The Half-and-half... The deadly Power Punch...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She was really upset because of $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh. I guess I won't hit you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: To tell you the truth, I've just been in a punching mood lately.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wish I'd never met $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't mean that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You have no idea how I feel!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honestly... I thought $ZOE was The One. I'd never been so happy with anyone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I never thought I could feel that good.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Just like I never thought I could feel this bad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just wish it had never happened.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. If you want to go running after your cousin... You're going to have to do it alone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sniff...
Sam walks sadly out of the diner.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe we should ask for the bill and go...
Outside in the parking lot, the guys are just leaving the diner when...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You messed with the wrong girl, Howard! I saw the whole thing go down from right outside.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `No one` makes Sam cry unless it's me. And I only do it by accident!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No one[/i][/color] makes Sam cry unless it's me. And I only do it by accident!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now tell me... Do you wanna get punched in the face or in the stomach? `Face or stomach?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now tell me... Do you wanna get punched in the face or in the stomach? [color=#e23b3b][i]Face or stomach?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't do it, man! It's over! $ZOE is gone! She's probably dating fifteen new guys already!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Fifteen?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think I'm going to be sick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Exactly! `Lovesick!` That means you and $ZOE need to get back together.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! [color=#3b78e2][i]Lovesick![/i][/color] That means you and $ZOE need to get back together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... Hector literally just made me sick to my stomach. Thinking of $ZOE with all of those guys...
Howard sprints to the restroom.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh... Maybe fifteen was kind of an exaggeration.
A few minutes later, Howard returns, looking slightly green.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honestly, no. I'm not okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Get her back, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've been down that road before, after Linda left me for Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But this is different, Howard! $ZOE didn't leave you for some loser in a tank top.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She `had` to go to be with her parents.
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to go to be with her parents.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I still feel just as bad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm not running after her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Perfect! He made the right decision without me saying a word!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay. Looks like there's nothing more I can do for Brendan at the moment.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Time for an even tougher challenge... Talking to Howard about $ZOE.
Hector is just about to open his mouth when Sam runs into the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard! There you are. I just wanted to know if you'd reconsidered my offer...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come with me! If we go after her together, I `know` we can convince $ZOE to come back!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come with me! If we go after her together, I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] we can convince $ZOE to come back!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh oh... I think I see a gleam in Howard's eye!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard is all about big romantic gestures... And if I know my boy, he's thinking about taking Sam up on her offer!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But even if Howard goes over there and gets back together with her, he'll just end up like Brendan, in some horrible long-distance relationship!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've got to...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan... You know how much I like Dinah. She's an awesome girl. The best.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But sometimes 'the best' isn't good enough anymore. Like, an even `better` 'best' comes along...
nodes.text_bbcode: But sometimes 'the best' isn't good enough anymore. Like, an even [color=#e23b3b][i]better[/i][/color] 'best' comes along...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because the 'best' you're with right now has headed off to college and gone completely insane.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think I'm starting to see why you failed the logic section of the state math exam.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: By `definition` there can be nothing better than the best.
nodes.text_bbcode: By [color=#e23b3b][i]definition[/i][/color] there can be nothing better than the best.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Therefore, your argument breaks down. Dinah is the best. I need to stay with her. I could never find a better match.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not here to argue over... Whatever it's called. Pedantics? Seminoles? Salmonellas?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Semantics?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whatever!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The point is, it's time to dump that girl and move on!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then we can set you up for a summer fling. I happen to know that Amanda has a `very` attractive cousin over on the Wilson side of town.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then we can set you up for a summer fling. I happen to know that Amanda has a [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] attractive cousin over on the Wilson side of town.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Er, don't tell Amanda I told you that. I mean. I'm not `personally` attracted to her cousin or anything. She's just objectively hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Er, don't tell Amanda I told you that. I mean. I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]personally[/i][/color] attracted to her cousin or anything. She's just objectively hot!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll just stop talking now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That sounds like a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, buddy, I'm going to tell this to you straight-up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's time for you and Dinah to break up. You had fun. Good times. Now it's time to hang up the saddle before someone gets hurt.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I see what you mean... It's like in 'Warscrewdriver Online' when your avatar is out of stamina but you're still trying to ride your mount.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And you just go slower and slower... Until you can't bear to ride anymore.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Speaking of which, you spend a `little` too much time playing that game.
nodes.text_bbcode: Speaking of which, you spend a [color=#e23b3b][i]little[/i][/color] too much time playing that game.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... That's a separate issue. The point is, yes. Time to get off the pony. Put it out to pasture. Let someone else give it a ride.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Would you please stop comparing my girlfriend to a horse?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually a pony is a completely different...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right. Point taken. But I hope you also take mine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know it's hard to hear, Brendan... But Hector kind of has a point.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Break up with Dinah? Man... Even saying the words out loud breaks my heart.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... I'll think about it.

nodes.title: Camping Trip Visions
nodes.subtitle: Time for some hiking, s'mores... And spirit animals?

nodes.text: It's the hottest day of summer, and Howard, Hector, and Brendan have taken refuge in the local diner.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw yeah! Nothing like a chocolate shake to beat the heat.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is what summer is all about. Good times. Chilling out all day. Hanging out with your bros...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And did I tell you that I got to go bikini shopping with Amanda yesterday?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... That's... Great.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awesome.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What is `with` you two? It's the middle of summer... The most fun time of the year!
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] you two? It's the middle of summer... The most fun time of the year!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you two are frowning the day away like your cats just died or something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's just hard to be happy when I know $ZOE is half a world away... Probably getting hit on by some French guy.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I feel you, buddy. Dinah might as well be in Europe. I thought she'd come back from college to see me this summer...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But instead, she's taking a special poetry summer school class.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The only emails I get from her anymore are all rhymes about her troubled relationship with her father.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Special summer poetry class? Latent daddy issues? Sounds like a Stage-7 Goth Chick Meltdown!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've read about these in the 'Player's Handbook'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Next thing you know, she'll be shaving her head and telling Brendan she wants an 'open relationship' so she can make out with some dude she met in a graveyard.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I need to drop some knowledge on him `now.` He needs me to be...
nodes.text_bbcode: I need to drop some knowledge on him [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color] He needs me to be...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I should have known Ben was trying to get together with her!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, now it's time for him to put down the popcorn... And eat my fist!
Colt swings at Ben, but his ghostly fists pass right through Ben's head!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stupid ghost fists! As soon as I get back to the real world, I'm going to pound his nerdy face in!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Hiss...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Would you be quiet for just `one second` kitten? I'm trying to deliver a beat-down here!
nodes.text_bbcode: Would you be quiet for just [color=#e23b3b][i]one second[/i][/color] kitten? I'm trying to deliver a beat-down here!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Hiss... Hiss...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? You're trying to say I'm missing the point of this vision?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, newsflash. I don't care. I don't have to listen to you. You're just a stupid kitten.
Suddenly, the kitten jumps on Colt's face and starts scratching wildly!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mommyyyyyyy!!!
After a few minutes of intense scratching, Colt finds himself back in the steam room...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never meant to hurt Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But... Here she is. Crying on that little nerd's shoulder about me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe she'd be better off if I just stayed away from her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: At least then she wouldn't get hurt.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe you should stay away from me too, kitten. You'll probably just end up getting hurt.
The kitten jumps up on Colt's lap.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Purr... Mrow?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You... You want me to pet you?
Colt looks around to make sure no one is watching.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, okay.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But if you ever tell `anyone` about this, I'm using your tail to clean my bike's exhaust pipe!
nodes.text_bbcode: But if you ever tell [color=#e23b3b][i]anyone[/i][/color] about this, I'm using your tail to clean my bike's exhaust pipe!

nodes.text: After petting the kitten for a few minutes, Colt returns to the darkness of the steam room.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If we're done here, I guess it's time for you to go play with a ball of yarn or something.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mowr!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Mowr'? You mean... 'More'? As in, there's something more?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mowr.
The kitten walks off into the swirling mists, and Colt follows.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where are we now? Some rich guy's house?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't believe your room has a built-in theater!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just a little makeshift one I threw together.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad uses this screen and projector to make presentations at work... And the popcorn is from the microwave.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I figured that if we were going to watch the sequel to your favorite movie of all-time, we should do it in style!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait... The `sequel` to `Rise of the Maskmaker`? That hasn't even come out in theaters yet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... The [color=#3b78e2][i]sequel[/i][/color] to [color=#3b78e2][i]Rise of the Maskmaker[/i][/color]? That hasn't even come out in theaters yet!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Luckily I know a guy who knows a guy who knows an unscrupulous janitor at Unimountal Studios!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow... That's so nice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So why don't you look happy?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've just had a lot on my mind lately.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean Colt, don't you?
Denni starts sniffling, and Ben pulls her in for a hug.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is `this` supposed to show me, kitten?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] supposed to show me, kitten?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hm... Maybe it's that...

options.label: Ben is trying to move in on Denni!
I've hurt Denni, just like I hurt Sam.

nodes.text: The kitten brushes up against Colt's legs and looks up at him happily.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Purr...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's it, isn't it? I need to really let Sammy have this break... For both of our sakes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This isn't going to be easy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow. Mrow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Anyway. Thanks for the vision.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! That's it! I'll just work my way through the whole swim team and make her insanely jealous!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe I'll start with Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Hiss...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or maybe Jane? She's kind of feisty!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sara? She's kind of sheltered, but if that's what you want...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Hiss! Hiss! Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well now I'm just confused.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally, some peace and quiet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wonder if these preppy dudes actually believe in this 'spirit animal' stuff.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course, if I `did` have a spirit animal, I'm sure it would be something awesome.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course, if I [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] have a spirit animal, I'm sure it would be something awesome.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe a huge wolf. Or a barracuda. Or a barracuda riding a wolf!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh? Are you lost?
The kitten shakes its head.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure you are. You probably meant to go to Brendan's fantasy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay! Geez. Don't get so angry!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow.
The kitten walks away into the mist, and Colt follows it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where are we?
Colt and the kitten float in the air above a girls' slumber party.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! It's Sammy and her friends!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Peeking in at a slumber party? I like your style, kitten.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow.
The girls start asking Sam questions about Colt... And after a while she says...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I finally realized that... It's just not a good idea for me and Colt to be together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe someday we'll be together, but I'd have to forgive him first, and that will take a long time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As hard as that is for me to admit.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't get it, kitten. Why did you bring me here? Is it because...

nodes.prompt: Why did you bring me here. Is it because...

options.label: You think I need to commit to my breakup with Sam?
You think I should hook up with Sam's friends?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Why did you bring me here. Is it because...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah is here in 'Collegelandia' learning new spells, fighting new monsters, and leveling up past my current cap!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: While I'm still stuck in high school, doing the same old thing.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Very astute, young adventurer.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So I guess... I guess I subconsciously realize that she needs to go on this adventure without me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But what does that mean for our relationship?!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: That is something only you can know.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: For now, our work is done...
The mists swirl around Brendan...
And when they part, he finds himself back in the darkness of the steam room.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Uh... No. I think you're missing the point here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No `wonder` she's felt most distant lately! She's probably been busy beta-testing the new realm...
nodes.text_bbcode: No [color=#e23b3b][i]wonder[/i][/color] she's felt most distant lately! She's probably been busy beta-testing the new realm...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She probably just didn't want to tell me because she knew I'd be jealous.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: That seems like quite a deductive leap...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I bet Dinah is totally planning to hook me up with a copy of the new expansion too! She's the best girlfriend ever!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Really? That's what you're getting from this?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Sigh... I knew I should have signed up for a different gig.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Did you know I was on the short-list to replace 'Flamey the Bear'?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: 'Kids, only you can prevent florist fires.'

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Or was it 'forest fliers'?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Forest fires'?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: SILENCE!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: This whole thing just hasn't gone according to plan at all...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Time to send you back...
The mists swirl, and Brendan finds himself back in the steam room.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... But my level is totally maxed out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I can't level up any more until the next expansion comes out!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Don't you see, Brendan? Dinah `has` reached the next expansion!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you see, Brendan? Dinah [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] reached the next expansion!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: We're on the isle of `Collegelandia!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're on the isle of [color=#e23b3b][i]Collegelandia![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I think I understand.

options.label: Dinah got a pre-release copy of the newest expansion!

nodes.text: Brendan grabs a handful of sand and throws it into the Walrusoar King's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now to attack!
Brendan swings a massive axe at the Walrusoar...
But the blade bounces right off its skin!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In that case, it seems like a good time to...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: RUN!
Brendan and Kobriak run down the beach away from the Walrusoar King.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: At least I didn't get killed and sent back to the Summon Portal.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't understand, though... This is the best axe in the game...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But it can't even pierce his flesh.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Maybe that's because the Walrusoar King is fifteen levels higher than you!
Brendan curls into a ball as the Walrusoar King looks down in pity.
Seeing that there's no fight in him, the beast slumps down, using Brendan as a pillow.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oof! This thing... Weighs... A ton.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Fourteen tons, actually.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Urk...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Don't worry. Walrusoars only tend to sleep for ten hours at a time, maximum.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ten... Hours?
Ten hours later...

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Looks like that Walrusoar is finally gone.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hack... Wheeze.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Everything... Smells like... Walrusoar.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but this is what you get for trying to defeat a monster that's too high above your level.
And with that, the mists clear, and Howard finds himself back in the darkness of the steam room.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's nice relaxing in the steam... I hope I get to meet my spirit animal.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I wonder... Must it be a real-world animal, or could mine be a mythological beast?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Perhaps a hippogriff... Or a cockatrice!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Or maybe... A talking bear!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kobriak! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Shouldn't you be busy guiding players through the land of Sh'aaladoom in 'Warscrewdriver Online'?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Ha! You think the all-powerful Kobriak doesn't have the power to be in multiple places at once?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Do you?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Well, no... But luckily my 'Warscrewdriver Online' server is down, so I had time to make it over here!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Now... Follow me!
Brendan and Kobriak find themselves on a strange and unfamiliar island.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey... Where are we? I don't recognize this place.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: No, of course you wouldn't. You don't know this place at all. But `she` does.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, of course you wouldn't. You don't know this place at all. But [color=#e23b3b][i]she[/i][/color] does.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Take `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Take [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Dinah summons a flaming meteor that lands on a nearby Walrusoar.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kobriak! Where are we? How did she learn 'Meteor Strike'?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That spell isn't supposed to be available until the next expansion.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: An interesting observation... But perhaps you should concentrate on a more important matter right now.
A `Walrusoar King` attacks Brendan!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [b]Walrusoar King[/b] attacks Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do I do?!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: You're finally getting it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE's kindness rubs off on everyone around her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In a way it's like she actually helps Sam and Colt be better people.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: And...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And she makes me a better person too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Monkey... I miss her so much! I need her back!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: So you `do` want her to exist!
nodes.text_bbcode: So you [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] want her to exist!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I guess I was just lying to myself.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honestly, I feel like I'd do anything just to see her one more time.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: `Anything?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Anything?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Perhaps you could... Imagine a banana?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that really going to work?
Suddenly, a banana plummets from the sky and lands directly in the monkey's paw.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Well done!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: And now for my part of the deal... Let's go see $ZOE!
Mists swirl around Howard and the monkey. When they part, he's in girl's bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do I hear... Crying?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, come on. We've got tickets to the Louvre! And your father has promised to take us to the top of the Eiffel Tower!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Mom. I don't mean to be so upset...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just spent so much time trying to hide how bad I was feeling back in the U.S.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Howard had known how awful I really felt, it would have broken his heart.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Aw... Well, he sounds like a very nice boy.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But I also happen to know that there are plenty of `other` nice boys here in France.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I also happen to know that there are plenty of [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] nice boys here in France.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And you're not going to meet them here in this hotel room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... I guess you're right. Maybe I should come out and at least see the city...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! No! Stay in the hotel room! `Stay in the hotel room!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE! No! Stay in the hotel room! [color=#e23b3b][i]Stay in the hotel room![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Sorry... But she can't hear you.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Of course, once you get back to real life...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Anyway, our time is just about up.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Thanks for playing, and I'll see you next time you get a concussion playing football!
The monkey starts screeching!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Hilarious? Hilarious?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Maybe I haven't told you enough...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Like, did you know that without $ZOE's calming influence, Kay and Kel would have burned down your house with fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That... Is... Funny.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: And without $ZOE around, you would have gone through an embarrassing goth phase following your tenth breakup with Linda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've always... Wanted... To try... Black lipstick.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Did I mention that you would have been hospitalized after Wilson High's Fourth of July water balloon assault?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Laugh... A... Minute.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Fine! Fine! I give up.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I knew you looked dumb. Have it your way. Go sweat it out and think about your mistake.
When the mists clear, Howard sees the cheerleaders trying to form a pyramid.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Time to see how $ZOE's absence would have affected some of the other people you know...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why isn't this working?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It feels like we're missing someone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or maybe you're just getting too chubby to hold up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why are you so mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I was just born this way.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Do you see, Howard? If $ZOE had never existed, there would have been no one around to check Sam's temper.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Which means she would have treated Colt worse than ever, leading to some unexpected results!
Nearby...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm tired of Sammy treating me like dirt... And I'm sure she's cheating on me with one of these Centerscore guys!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But which one?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Only one solution. I'll beat them all up. Starting with that one over there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh. Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nope... But I'm about to introduce you to my `fists!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nope... But I'm about to introduce you to my [color=#e23b3b][i]fists![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: `Now` do you understand?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Now[/i][/color] do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think so. Without $ZOE around... Without her, the world...

options.label: Would have less kindness in it.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well let me tell you right now, it's about to get real!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm sorry Howard... But to win back Linda's hand for the seventeenth time, I must do this!
Kenji swings the sword and barely misses slicing Howard in half.
Instead, the blade cuts through Howard's shirt and pants, which fall to the floor, leaving him half-naked!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yikes!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, Kenji... Seeing Howard like this just reminds me that your body is so much better than his!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Want me to slice my shirt off too?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heck yeah!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: `Still` think your life would have been better without $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Still[/i][/color] think your life would have been better without $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Grrr... Yes... This seems... Awesome.
The monkey sadly shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Looks like you need some more convincing...
The mists swirl around Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I don't `completely` wish $ZOE had never existed.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]completely[/i][/color] wish $ZOE had never existed.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I knew you weren't as dumb as you look!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: But since it sounds like you aren't `sure` I want to show you something else...
nodes.text_bbcode: But since it sounds like you aren't [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] I want to show you something else...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Oh, one second.
The monkey grabs a banana from the cafeteria salad bar.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Mmm... Banana...
Steam swirls around Howard and the monkey...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Have you ever noticed how putting the word 'magic' in front of any other word makes that word sound `way` cooler?
nodes.text_bbcode: Have you ever noticed how putting the word 'magic' in front of any other word makes that word sound [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] cooler?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Magic hairball? Magic hobo? Magic ninja?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...and the magic `steam room` is as cool as it gets!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...and the magic [color=#e23b3b][i]steam room[/i][/color] is as cool as it gets!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Boys, follow me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Welcome to the magic steam room!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why is it so dark?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's part of the magic... It's like a sensory deprivation chamber.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No sights to distract you. No talking. It's just you and your thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: As the steam flows around you, your mind wanders to the deepest part of your subconscious.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And that's when you see your `spirit animal!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And that's when you see your [color=#e23b3b][i]spirit animal![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So have you seen some crazy stuff in the past?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Me? Uh... Nah. I'm immune. This is all for you guys.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now who's ready to see a magic vision?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you sure it's not just your brain cooking in the heat?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There's no talking in the magic steam room, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And shouldn't we change into our bathing suits?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No talking!
The guys go silent and close their eyes as the hot steam flows around them.
Whose vision do you want to see first?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not totally convinced this is going to work, but it's nice sitting here, enjoying the silence...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Waaaaah! Waaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Except for that stupid monkey screeching in my ear!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... `'Stupid monkey screeching in my ear'?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... [color=#e23b3b][i]'Stupid monkey screeching in my ear'?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: 'Sup.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can talk?!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Wow. You're `so` smart. Glad to be a part of such a genius's dreamscape.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. You're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] smart. Glad to be a part of such a genius's dreamscape.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why are you so mean?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Zip it. Okay, here's how we're going to run this hallucination.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: You wished earlier that $ZOE had never existed...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Well, now you're going to get your wish.
The mists around Howard swirl...
And when they part, he finds himself hovering over the high school cafeteria, looking down at the people below.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda! There you are... I've been looking all over for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's me!
Linda runs up to Howard, throws her arms around him, and kisses him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so happy we're finally back together.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know, baby! Seventeenth time is the charm, right?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Not if I have anything to say about it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji... You're back from your trip to Japan? Did you find your long-lost relatives?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I sure did... And they hooked me up with a long-lost family relic!
Kenji pulls a samurai sword out from behind his back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This seems unlikely. Kenji never mentioned anything about any long-lost relatives.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm pretty sure he's never even `been` to Japan.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm pretty sure he's never even [color=#e23b3b][i]been[/i][/color] to Japan.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Whatever, buddy. Don't blame me. This is `your` subconscious. Maybe you shouldn't have watched all of those Chirosawa movies last week.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever, buddy. Don't blame me. This is [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] subconscious. Maybe you shouldn't have watched all of those Chirosawa movies last week.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stupid samurai movie marathon.
Kenji twirls the sword over his head.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... Hot! Can I hold it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure. Just as soon as I finish dueling Howard for your love.
Howard picks up a cafeteria butter knife.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bring it on!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: So... What do you think? Still think you'd have been better off without $ZOE?

options.label: I may have made a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's all jump in the hot tub!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't have a hot tub! Sniff.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just a loser. A loser with no hot tub!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! Hector, buddy, you're taking this way too hard!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. At least you still have that sweet steam room, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That... That's right! The magic steam room!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a second. Didn't you say something about a steam room?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's right! Thanks for reminding me!
Hector pulls Colt in for a bro-hug.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa. That kind of thing would get you shivved back in juvie!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well consider it your welcome-back hug to the outside world!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gentlemen, I think it's time we head to the magic steam room!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! Hector, buddy, you're taking this way too hard!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. At least you still have that sweet steam room, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That... That's right! The magic steam room!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's all get in that mud bath Hector was talking about earlier!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't have a mud bath. Sniff.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just a loser. A loser with no mud bath!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! Hector, buddy, you're taking this way too hard!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. At least you still have that sweet steam room, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That... That's right! The magic steam room!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's all go ride that water slide Hector was talking about earlier!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't have a water slide. Sniff.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just a loser. A loser with no water slide!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! Hector, buddy, you're taking this way too hard!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. At least you still have that sweet steam room, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That... That's right! The magic steam room!
A little later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're back... With enough fish for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awesome! Looks like we'll have something to eat besides s'mores tonight!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We were only going to have s'mores for dinner?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... We... Are... Back.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is everything okay? Why are you so tired? Are you on the run from the cops?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If they ask about me, you just tell them we've been hanging out non-stop for the last two weeks, and I `don't` know anything about any missing lawn gnomes!
nodes.text_bbcode: If they ask about me, you just tell them we've been hanging out non-stop for the last two weeks, and I [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] know anything about any missing lawn gnomes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, no. It was just kind of a tough hike.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But we definitely worked up an appetite!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right on! I think there should still be everything we need to make s'mores up in my uncle's cabinet.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're having s'mores for dinner?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, guys. I didn't have it in me to shop for groceries.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bro, I go shopping with Amanda like every night these days. I couldn't take it again, even at the grocery store.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait a second. Aren't you always saying your relationship is perfect?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But your chick makes you go shopping `every` day?
nodes.text_bbcode: But your chick makes you go shopping [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] day?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're not here to talk about `my` relationship! I'm the one leading this camping trip!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're not here to talk about [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] relationship! I'm the one leading this camping trip!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I told you, everything is perfect!!!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yikes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This just went from `slightly` awkward to 'nerd at a pool party' awkward.
nodes.text_bbcode: This just went from [color=#e23b3b][i]slightly[/i][/color] awkward to 'nerd at a pool party' awkward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hector must be actually worried about how Amanda treats him if he's letting it get to him like this.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone calm down! It's time for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You mean s'mores?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes I mean s'mores!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's hope this camping trip gets better soon. I've had more fun hanging out in juvie...
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No more... Marshmallows.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But you kept saying you want 's'more'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I was trying to be funny!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So what now? More TV?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Guys? I hate to be the one to say it, but we can't just sit around watching TV all night.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So what do you suggest?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a second. Earlier, didn't Hector say something about a...

nodes.prompt: Didn't Hector say something about a...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Didn't Hector say something about a...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, uh, there are a lot of hot chicks at school, huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Definitely.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I mean, of course, it's hard to beat Sammy...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Unless you count Amanda, that is.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah. Amanda. She is kind of hot. You know, I've never hooked up with a redhead...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, it's no time to start! Trust me, bro, I don't exactly think you're Amanda's type.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Easy there, 'bro'. I'm just saying redheads are hot. I'm not trying to steal your chick.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good! Because I know for a `fact` that Amanda `hates` hot guys who ride motorcycles and play guitar!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good! Because I know for a [color=#e23b3b][i]fact[/i][/color] that Amanda [color=#e23b3b][i]hates[/i][/color] hot guys who ride motorcycles and play guitar!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And have perfect hair... And who every girl at school would die to date.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, this got awkward.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing to do now but wait it out until the other guys get back...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... I notice that party van of yours is pretty tricked-out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Glad you noticed. It may not look like much, but I've got a V-12 engine under the hood...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not to mention enough cup holders in the back to accommodate eight lovely ladies.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not bad. I've only got enough room on my bike to fit one chick at a time. That's why I have to make sure she's hot.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Quality not quantity. Respect. I mean, these days I'm a one-woman man myself.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For sure. You and Amanda seem to have a good thing going... Just like Sammy and I used to.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. Amanda is basically the perfect woman.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure, man. I'm sure she's cool. I used to think Sammy was perfect too.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But you know how it goes. After a few months, you start to see how that 'perfect' girl actually has a few flaws.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And before you know it, she's getting on your case for sneaking into police headquarters so you can steal back the illegal nitrous boosters the cops stripped off of your motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trust me, every relationship has an expiration date.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Buddy, I `know` so.
nodes.text_bbcode: Buddy, I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] so.

nodes.text: Meanwhile, back at the house, Colt silently flips through TV channels.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So, uh, Colt. I feel like we never talk.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yup.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... I'm sure we have some common ground. What are you into? Parties and music? Music and parties?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nah. I've seen Centerscore parties...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Some girl crying thanks to an awkward game of Truth or Dare...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Some DJ's lame mega-mix playing in the background...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Lame mega-mix?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Honestly, I think music is for suckers. Just a bunch of noise arranged so girls can think it's pretty.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Me, I'm the silent type.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I thought you played the guitar.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Like I said, chicks dig it. Same reason I pretend to like kittens and unicorns.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But as far as I'm concerned, the world would be a better place if songs never got invented.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A world with no music?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh boy. If I keep going on like this, he's going to start blubbering into a monogrammed doily.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe I should try to figure out a subject where we actually have something in common.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hector... Slick, buddy, champ. Let's talk about...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's hike to the top of the mountain!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Cool, there's a trail over there.
Half an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huff.... Lungs on fire... Legs can't go on.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It must be this thin mountain air. I can barely catch my breath.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I feel like I'm down to one hit point... And I'm poisoned with Giant Scorpion's Venom. And I've got a Banshee's Curse on me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm starting to think you play way too much 'Warscrewdriver Online'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's head back now. Maybe Hector will still let us watch TV with him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I was supposed to spend this time figuring out my feelings about...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I think I'm getting a blister!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yikes! Okay, geez. We'll head back.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awesome! I've spent hours building up my character's fishing skills in 'Warscrewdriver Online'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I should be totally awesome at this!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I think fishing might be slightly different in real life.
Fifteen minutes later, in a rowboat in the middle of the lake...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huzzah! Another fish!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How many have you caught?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That makes a baker's dozen... But I've been throwing back the small ones.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I guess we've got enough fish now. I might just sit and think about $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sounds kind of like my life every day for the last few months.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You think about Dinah a lot?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. The distance is tough.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We `do` see each other online a lot, but in a way that almost makes it worse.
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] see each other online a lot, but in a way that almost makes it worse.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm just reminded that she's not here in Centerscore with me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I'm `definitely` glad $ZOE and I didn't try to do the long-distance thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] glad $ZOE and I didn't try to do the long-distance thing.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Don't sweat it, man. I'll head out with you. I've been meaning to get more sun. I'm starting to worry I have a vitamin-D deficiency...
Brendan and Howard walk outside as Colt and Hector settle in for a few hours of TV.
Outside, Howard leads Brendan into a grassy clearing.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, buddy. Here we are... Now what do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What I really want is something where I can relax and figure out what I'm thinking about $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I was hoping we could...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nice! We should check out Lisa's talk show! She used to go to Centerscore High, you know!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... She was friends with Elliana... My first girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The one who left me to move back to Brazil!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But even Elliana eventually came back to the U.S., right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who cares? The point is, she left me... Just like $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I should have known Howard would take it there.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No worries! We can watch something else! How about, 'Bikini Cheerleaders Versus the Zombie Horde'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sniff... $ZOE was a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can't keep linking everything back to $ZOE, bro! It's no fun for any of us!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think... I think I'm gonna go now.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, buddy, I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: An 'America's Top Biker Gang' marathon is about to come on!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You get cable out here?! I've been wanting to watch this show for years!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All I get at home is the Home Purchasing Network... And it's totally grainy.
Hector reaches into a micro-fridge and tosses Colt a cold bottle of root beer.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Best. Camping Trip. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... It does sound pretty good.
Howard and Brendan sit and watch.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is just how camping should be. Four bros. Four root beers. One bigscreen.
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Check it out! 'Zombie Summer Camp' is on next!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do we really want to watch a movie about zombies eating campers... When `we ourselves` are camping?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do we really want to watch a movie about zombies eating campers... When [color=#e23b3b][i]we ourselves[/i][/color] are camping?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Me too. Come on, Howard. Be a good camper and watch TV!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It sounds like fun, Hector...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I think I need to get away from the house for a little while, get out in nature and think about some things.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If that's what you need to do...
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gentlemen, we have arrived. Now who's ready to do some serious camping?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am. You know, Hector your were right...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now that we're up in the mountains, I'm starting to feel a little better already!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm `so` ready for this. I even brought my dad's old army tent!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] ready for this. I even brought my dad's old army tent!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I've got my authentic gryphon fur sleeping bag! Not to mention my genuine mithril camping dinette set!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... I brought this old tarp. I sometimes use it to cover my bike.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys, guys, guys! We don't need `any` of that stuff!
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys, guys, guys! We don't need [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] of that stuff!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do you really think a player like me would take you camping `outside?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you really think a player like me would take you camping [color=#e23b3b][i]outside?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, buddy, but that's what camping is.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, that's not how we do it in my family, son. Come on and follow me.
The guys emerge from the forest and see a huge mansion! Hector opens the door and lets them in.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Allow me to introduce you to camping, Hector-style... Where you can safely observe nature from the comfort of your king-sized bed.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Believe me, most animals are much more interesting on the other side of double-paned glass.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And did I mention the steam room? It's the best part of the whole trip! There's a rumor that if you stay inside long enough...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector! Enough!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You told us we were coming up here to get some fresh air!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't agree to come on this trip so we could all sit in bed together and look out a window!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honestly, that sounds a little creepy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now, I say we get out of the house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who's with me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know. It might be fun to get out, but now that I'm in here, it's kind of hard to leave.
Hector flips on the big-screen TV and hops onto a nearby armchair.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe if I find a show everyone likes I can get Howard to give up on this lame 'going outside' idea...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But which one do I suggest?

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think I realized that I'm supposed to get back together with Linda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: WHAT?! `WHAT?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: WHAT?! [color=#e23b3b][i]WHAT?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Someone put me in a headlock, 'cause I'm worried that my head is about to explode.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gladly.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: In this case, I must agree with Hector, Howard. This course of action seems inadvisable.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, guys, but my mind is made up. I'll win Linda back...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even if it means that I'll be cleaved in half by a samurai sword.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How would that possibly happen?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Take me to the Auto-Shop! Now! It's time for a `duel!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Take me to the Auto-Shop! Now! It's time for a [color=#e23b3b][i]duel![/i][/color]

nodes.text: An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Uh, Cuz? I think Howard is here to see you.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's he want now? I thought we were cool at this point.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, Kenji. I'm ready to go. Draw your sword!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh, what are you talking about? And why are you holding a spork?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's the best weapon I could find! Now where's yours?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: The only weapon I've ever needed are my fists.
Kenji charges forward and decks Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stupid... Monkey... Terrible... Advice.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I think he finally snapped.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: He he he.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go... Away.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah. Now I just feel kind of bad. Should we call an ambulance?
Megan shrugs.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah. Good point. Let's finish installing that alternator on your bike first.
Great. You managed to leave Howard half-conscious, mumbling about a monkey in the Auto-Shop.
It `seems` like this might not be the best ending. Want to try again?
nodes.text_bbcode: It [b]seems[/b] like this might not be the best ending. Want to try again?

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And now I'm more sure than ever about my relationship with Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're solid as a rock!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I thought that...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Solid. As. A. Rock.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, okay!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That I'm supposed to go kick some nerd butt.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That just doesn't seem like something a spirit animal would say...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are those scratch marks on your face?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gulp.
Okay... You've seen all three visions!
Now, for the final scene, we'll switch you back to Hector's point of view.
The next afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys! We accidentally fell asleep in the steam room!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Must... Get... Out of here! Out to somewhere cool!
The guys make it outside.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Is everyone okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I don't think so. First I had a weird dream about a monkey...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then another one about a magic hippo. And then one where I was a psychic turkey sandwich!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had that same dream! An old lady was trying to eat me... But she didn't have any teeth!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I had that dream too! What does it mean?! `What does it mean?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I had that dream too! What does it mean?! [color=#e23b3b][i]What does it mean?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No one freak out, okay! We just spent a little too long in the magic steam room, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What if every sandwich I've ever eaten was actually a conscious entity?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That would make you a murderer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stay... Stay away from me, all of you! How many sandwiches have you killed?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys! Everything is cool. We've all just got to calm down!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It was all just a dream... It was all just a dream!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, guys. Hector is right.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm not a sandwich anymore! I'm fine!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It was all just a dream! Everything is okay!
A kitten walks up and brushes against Colt's legs.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaah! It was real! It was all real!
Colt runs off into the distance, screaming his head off.
Sometimes you make a few too many wrong choices and things just go `crazy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sometimes you make a few too many wrong choices and things just go [b]crazy.[/b]

nodes.text: Maybe it's time to try again. See if you can earn an ending where Colt isn't terrified of kittens.

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys... I think we've been in here long enough. We'd better get out before we boil.
The guys walk out of the steam room and see the morning sun peeking out over the distant mountains.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So... Did you guys see your spirit animals?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I did. It was this really cute kit...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Er, I mean. A wolverine. It was a vicious, vicious wolverine.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And what did this 'wolverine' tell you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What about you, B-dawg? Any messages from the animal kingdom?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess that just leaves you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not totally convinced this is going to work, but it's nice sitting here, enjoying the silence...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Waaaaah! Waaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Except for that stupid monkey screeching in my ear!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... `'Stupid monkey screeching in my ear'?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... [color=#e23b3b][i]'Stupid monkey screeching in my ear'?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: 'Sup.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can talk?!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Wow. You're `so` smart. Glad to be a part of such a genius's dreamscape.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. You're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] smart. Glad to be a part of such a genius's dreamscape.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why are you so mean?

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Zip it. Okay, here's how we're going to run this hallucination.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: You wished earlier that $ZOE had never existed...

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Well, now you're going to get your wish.
The mists around Howard swirl...
And when they part, he finds himself hovering over the high school cafeteria, looking down at the people below.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda! There you are... I've been looking all over for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's me!
Linda runs up to Howard, throws her arms around him, and kisses him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so happy we're finally back together.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know, baby! Seventeenth time is the charm, right?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Not if I have anything to say about it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji... You're back from your trip to Japan? Did you find your long-lost relatives?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I sure did... And they hooked me up with a long-lost family relic!
Kenji pulls a samurai sword out from behind his back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This seems unlikely. Kenji never mentioned anything about any long-lost relatives.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm pretty sure he's never even `been` to Japan.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm pretty sure he's never even [color=#e23b3b][i]been[/i][/color] to Japan.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Whatever, buddy. Don't blame me. This is `your` subconscious. Maybe you shouldn't have watched all of those Chirosawa movies last week.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever, buddy. Don't blame me. This is [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] subconscious. Maybe you shouldn't have watched all of those Chirosawa movies last week.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stupid samurai movie marathon.
Kenji twirls the sword over his head.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... Hot! Can I hold it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure. Just as soon as I finish dueling Howard for your love.
Howard picks up a cafeteria butter knife.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bring it on!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: So... What do you think? Still think you'd have been better off without $ZOE?

options.label: I may have made a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's nice relaxing in the steam... I hope I get to meet my spirit animal.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I wonder... Must it be a real-world animal, or could mine be a mythological beast?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Perhaps a hippogriff... Or a cockatrice!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Or maybe... A talking bear!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kobriak! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Shouldn't you be busy guiding players through the land of Sh'aaladoom in 'Warscrewdriver Online'?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Ha! You think the all-powerful Kobriak doesn't have the power to be in multiple places at once?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Do you?

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Well, no... But luckily my 'Warscrewdriver Online' server is down, so I had time to make it over here!

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: Now... Follow me!
Brendan and Kobriak find themselves on a strange and unfamiliar island.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey... Where are we? I don't recognize this place.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: No, of course you wouldn't. You don't know this place at all. But `she` does.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, of course you wouldn't. You don't know this place at all. But [color=#e23b3b][i]she[/i][/color] does.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Take `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Take [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Dinah summons a flaming meteor that lands on a nearby Walrusoar.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kobriak! Where are we? How did she learn 'Meteor Strike'?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That spell isn't supposed to be available until the next expansion.

nodes.speaker: Kobriak
nodes.text: An interesting observation... But perhaps you should concentrate on a more important matter right now.
A `Walrusoar King` attacks Brendan!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [b]Walrusoar King[/b] attacks Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do I do?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally, some peace and quiet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wonder if these preppy dudes actually believe in this 'spirit animal' stuff.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course, if I `did` have a spirit animal, I'm sure it would be something awesome.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course, if I [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] have a spirit animal, I'm sure it would be something awesome.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe a huge wolf. Or a barracuda. Or a barracuda riding a wolf!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh? Are you lost?
The kitten shakes its head.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure you are. You probably meant to go to Brendan's fantasy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay! Geez. Don't get so angry!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow.
The kitten walks away into the mist, and Colt follows it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where are we?
Colt and the kitten float in the air above a girls' slumber party.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! It's Sammy and her friends!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Peeking in at a slumber party? I like your style, kitten.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrow.
The girls start asking Sam questions about Colt... And after a while she says...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I finally realized that... It's just not a good idea for me and Colt to be together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe someday we'll be together, but I'd have to forgive him first, and that will take a long time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As hard as that is for me to admit.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't get it, kitten. Why did you bring me here? Is it because...

nodes.text: But I'm not sure it's a message I wanted to hear...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm going to have to really think about my relationship with Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nice! I'm glad to hear Brendan is finally coming around!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys... I'm not sure if what I saw was real or not.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I did realize one thing in there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The way I feel about $ZOE `is` real.
nodes.text_bbcode: The way I feel about $ZOE [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] real.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that's why I'm going after her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you listening to yourself, bro?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not like you can just hop on a bus to the next town over and track her down...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's all the way over in France!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then I guess I'd better go book a flight.
And later...

nodes.speaker: Aunt Cathy
nodes.text: Sam... A boy is calling. He says it's something about a trip to Europe.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard! I knew he'd come around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just hold on for a few more days, $ZOE... We're coming to get you!
Nice work! It looks like you managed to put Howard on the right path!
But you'll have to tune in next time to see how things pan out with him and $ZOE!
